# sql-format-lint

> Format SQL deterministically with a quote-aware tokenizer, one clause per line and uppercase keywords, and lint queries for six common mistakes with line and column Python package `trysac-sql-format-lint`, import name `sql_format_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
